# awscc_logs_storage_tier_policy (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::Logs::StorageTierPolicy. Manages the storage tier policy for a CloudWatch Logs account. When created, enables Intelligent-Tiering which automatically moves infrequently accessed log data to lower-cost storage tiers. Deleting this resource reverts the account to standard (single-tier) storage.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `storage_tier` (String) The storage tier to apply. Only INTELLIGENT_TIERING is accepted for creation.

### Read-Only

- `account_id` (String) The AWS account ID that owns this storage tier policy.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `last_updated_time` (Number) Timestamp (milliseconds after Jan 1, 1970 00:00:00 UTC) when the storage tier policy was last updated.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_logs_storage_tier_policy.example
  identity = {
    account_id = "account_id"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform

  to = awscc_logs_storage_tier_policy.example
  id = "account_id"

```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:
